description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {1}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Priest of Urabrask.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve Seething Anger, causing target creature to get +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.
